build.title: axHub: OAuth 2.1 sign-in on /mcp so claude.ai custom connectors connect

said.text: Repo MossesX/axHub. Pre-registered client from AXHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / AXHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET (Coolify), discovery (RFC 9728 + RFC 8414), /oauth/authorize with hub admin sign-in + consent, /oauth/token (authorization_code + PKCE S256 required, client secret, refresh rotation with reuse detection), /oauth/revoke, hashed tokens in storage (migration 5, contract tests), tokens act as the owner with the same approval rules, AXHUB_MCP_TOKEN keeps working. Branch + PR, not merged.

steps.text: Storage: oauth_tokens repository (memory + SQLite, migration 5, contract test, prune)
Authorize: admin sign-in, consent page, codes with PKCE
Token + revoke endpoints, refresh rotation, bearer auth accepts OAuth tokens
Tests, CLI list/revoke, docs + decision log, PR
